title.zh: 多可用区实例关闭一个已有的可用区
title.en: Disable a zone for a multi-zone instance

descriptions.zh: 多可用区实例关闭一个已有的可用区 ， 仅用于容灾演练，请慎重操作！
descriptions.en: Disables an existing zone for a multi-zone instance. This operation is intended only for disaster recovery drills. Proceed with caution.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun elasticsearch turn-off-zone --instance-id es-cn-abc --zone cn-hangzhou-i --hp-alb-zone-drained true --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
